The main takeaway from our work is that
the Laplace transform representation for the joint distribution of sojourn and inter-sojourn times is a very powerful tool for the transient analysis of continuous-time Markov chains.

the sequence of sojour times in U and/or D can be used as an alternative to traditional quantities such as reliability, cumulative up time and availability for characterizing the behaviour of a Markov model.
the sojourn times provide a more natural framework for modelling and analysing the transient behaviour of Markov processes.
